shared_elements: repeated flower heads in a register or band
stylized plant/floral forms with radiating petals
justification: Both surfaces are shallow relief carvings whose only real overlap is a repeated stylized multi-petalled flower/rosette motif arranged in registers, rendered in similarly flat, outlined, schematic fashion. A shows a narrative procession of human figures in profile with weapons, headgear and a horse's head above a floral border, whereas B is purely vegetal — a tall column of flowering stems with palmette-like buds and no figures at all — so the subjects and their relationships differ almost entirely.
